text_block_list.text:
You go, Найс Нэйчер! You were amazing
out
there!
text_block_list.name: Spectators

text_block_list.text:
I was disappointed that Teio wasn't in
the race,
but... you run so well!
text_block_list.name: Spectators

text_block_list.text:
The cries echoing from the spectator
seats say it
all... Найс Нэйчер made this
race her own.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Trainer! I ran the race my way, right?
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: I'm glad... Hehe.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Well, if this is how the Kikuka Sho ends
for me,
then I'm not complaining! I'll give
myself a few
pats on the back!
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер
choice_data_list:
I now present you with... the "Job Well Done"
award!

text_block_list.text: Oh, another handmade trophy!
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
I gave Найс Нэйчер an origami trophy at
the
Kokura Kinen to boost her
confidence. She's
come to expect it, so I
did it again.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
...I can't believe you made another.
Hehe, this
one's floppy too.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: Nice. Let's do the award ceremony later.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
You can congratulate me on my success
then. ♪
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
...Kidding. I can't get too cocky here. It
wouldn't
have been like this if Teio was
here.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
I wonder if she's okay... and how bad the
injury
is...
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Even Teio must be feeling down after
not getting
to participate.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер
choice_data_list: I'm sure she'll be all right.

text_block_list.text: You're right. She must be.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
It's Teio we're talking about, after all.
She'll just
say something like, "I'm
invincible!" and come
back in no time.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: ...I have to be stronger by then.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер
choice_data_list: We still have a big race left.

text_block_list.text:
Huh? Big race? But it's almost winter.
What big
races take place then?
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: Gasp! You don't mean...
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер
choice_data_list: Why don't we aim for the Arima Kinen?

text_block_list.text:
Найс Нэйчер had a good showing in the
Kikuka
Sho and has a strong fan base.
Surely she can
take on the Arima Kinen
now!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Besides, the Arima Kinen will bring out
some of
this year's most notable racers.
Running with them
will help her grow
even more.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: The Arima Kinen, huh?
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
That would be the perfect race to repay
the
people who always support me.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
...It might be impossible for me to win.
Even if I
enter, it might all go up in
smoke once the gates
open. Still...
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: I want to compete in the Arima Kinen!
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
And so, we decide that the last race of
her classic
year is going to be the Arima
Kinen!
text_block_list.name: Монолог
